projection: Whole UTF-8 TEXT retained; substitutions only, CRLF/CR normalized to LF; no record/pointer/line omission or JSON reserialization.
variant_discovery: Raw text and recursively decoded JSON string tokens, including keys, inspected without clipping. Discovery supports slash/backslash, Unicode-escaped, case and percent-encoded spellings. Synthetic fixtures test recursively embedded JSON, escaped identities/paths and alternate path spellings; evidence uses only its frozen discovered mapping.
private_mapping: Ordered exact spellings and original source paths retained privately at mode0600; not for integration.
